sideB.text:
DATA TRANSFER

Two players (anywhere on the board) can swap 1 Player card from their hands.

Play at any time. Not an action.
sideB.footer: Play at any time. Not an action.

mechanics.whenRead: Taken with the other new Rationed Events when 01-07 is read, at the end of the first January game. Kept in the reserve and added to the Rationed Event pool.
rules: Two players (anywhere on the board) can swap 1 Player card from their hands.
Play at any time. Not an action.
Any two players, wherever they are on the board, swap 1 Player card from their hands.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the shared rationed-event back (haven in a signal ring, yellow bars, red arc). No printed card code and no rules text. The parenthetical 'anywhere on the board' is italic. The screen title is DATA TRANSFER.
